hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eiq 'git[[:space:]]+commit|git[[:space:]]+push|git[[:space:]]+rebase|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|--amend' && { echo 'Blocked by project policy (CLAUDE.md, "Git / commit expectations"): git commit, git push, git rebase, git reset --hard, and any --amend are reserved for the human developer. Stop here and hand the diff back instead of running this yourself.' 1>&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
